UnitStatement: The file examples/rule_packs/invented_demo.yaml is software demonstration content only.
The invented_demo.yaml example is not an engineering design basis, not a standards interpretation, not a project specification, and not suitable for professional reliance.
The example uses original invented values and labels to demonstrate the OpenPipeStress rule-pack schema surface.

The example must not be used as a source of engineering criteria, material properties, stress limits, allowables, SIF/flexibility data, dimensional tables, owner requirements, vendor data, or code compliance decisions.
Any real rule pack must be supplied by a responsible user or organization.
Any real rule pack must be reviewed for provenance and redistribution rights, and kept private where required.
Any real rule pack must be evaluated by competent human engineering judgment before use on a real project.
The software may report user-rule checked, user-rule failed, missing-input, or human-review-required states.
The software does not certify, approve, seal, authenticate, or declare engineering code compliance for reliance.
